title: The confirmed controllers and the fixed rule against BBRv3
description: BBRv3 is the reference for every comparison (docs/methodology.md, comparing controllers). experiments/versus_reference.py sets each controller against BBRv3 on the same validation episodes: the references and widths of the confirmed controllers (their rollouts in exp-ground-rl-confirm-32), Cubic (exp-teachers-val-35, beside BBRv3 itself), and the fixed rule, whose rollouts this run makes on the same episodes with ground.py rollouts (the rule as the trainer evaluates it, setup/rule/rule-u0.25.onnx of the confirmation's setup, made again by the same prepare; the training links are cut to one episode). The same campaign and seeds give the same episodes: the validation campaign is a fixed list of links and every episode's seed is 7 plus its place in it, as in the trainer's evaluation. For each, the log utility minus BBRv3's, paired by link, without and with a competing flow, with a bootstrap 95% interval over links; trained well means the whole interval above -0.1 in both. The rule's own rollouts also let the trainer's evaluations, which are paired with the rule, be set against BBRv3 per link and condition. The test links are not read.
run: mkdir -p "$OUT/rule-s1"; cp "$OUT/setup/ppo-base.json" "$OUT/rule-s1/ppo_spec.json"; cp "$OUT/setup/rule/rule-u0.25.onnx" "$OUT/rule-s1/policy.onnx"; uv run python experiments/ground.py rollouts "$OUT/rule-s1" --links 1 --fit "$OUT/setup/paths/campaign.json" --score "$OUT/setup/eval/campaign.json" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"; uv run python experiments/versus_reference.py "$OUT/versus-bbr3" "$IN/ground"/ref-* "$IN/ground"/ctl-* "$IN/teachers"/stock-* "$OUT/rule-s1"
